description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy of different reinforcement learning (RL) methods, both with and without self-reflection, across three subjects: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The vertical axis represents accuracy, measured in percentage, ranging from 50% to 62%. The horizontal axis lists the subjects. Each bar is color-coded and patterned to distinguish between the methods: DAPO+Self-reflection (blue), DAPO (orange), GRPO (green), SRPO (light blue), PPO+Self-reflection (dark green), and PPO (light green). The chart shows that for all subjects, the methods with self-reflection generally have higher accuracy than those without. The accuracy values for each method and subject are as follows: Mathverse (DAPO+Self-reflection: 62%, DAPO: 56%, GRPO: 54%, SRPO: 52%, PPO+Self-reflection: 58%, PPO: 56%), MMLU (DAPO+Self-reflection: 58%, DAPO: 56%, GRPO: 56%, SRPO: 54%, PPO+Self-reflection: 60%, PPO: 58%), and Physics (DAPO+Self-reflection: 60%, DAPO: 58%, GRPO: 58%, SRPO: 56%, PPO+Self-reflection: 62%, PPO: 60%). The chart does not indicate any specific sorting or emphasis on any bars.
